        SELECT investor_id,

        INNER JOIN cash c ON p.investor_id = c.investor_id
        INNER JOIN shift s ON p.investor_id = s.investor_id
    ) sub

    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Deposit','Lump Sum','SIP','Interest Credit','Dividend Reinvestment','Tax Refund')
                    THEN amount

    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
cash_flow_amt AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(amount) AS avg_cash_flow_amount
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
risk_score_cte AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(risk_score) AS avg_risk_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
goal_progress_cte AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_goal_progress
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
)
SELECT

    AVG(n.net_cash_flow) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
    AVG(a.avg_cash_flow_amount) AS avg_cash_flow_amount,
    AVG(r.avg_risk_score) AS avg_risk_score,
    AVG(g.avg_goal_progress) AS avg_goal_progress
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
LEFT JOIN cash_flow_net n ON p.investor_id = n.investor_id
LEFT JOIN cash_flow_amt a ON p.investor_id = a.investor_id
LEFT JOIN risk_score_cte r ON p.investor_id = r.investor_id
LEFT JOIN goal_progress_cte g ON p.investor_id = g.investor_id

ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

WITH cash AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holding AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND current_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
scenario AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_scenario_shift
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT p.investor_id,
           c.net_cash_flow,
           h.total_holding_gain,
           s.total_scenario_shift
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
    INNER JOIN cash c ON p.investor_id = c.investor_id
    INNER JOIN holding h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
    INNER JOIN scenario s ON p.investor_id = s.investor_id
)
SELECT investor_id,
       100.0 * ((norm_cash_flow + norm_holding_gain + norm_scenario_shift) / 3.0) AS composite_score
FROM (
    SELECT *,
           (net_cash_flow - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER()) / NULLIF((MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER() - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER()), 0) AS norm_cash_flow,
           (total_holding_gain - MIN(total_holding_gain) OVER()) / NULLIF((MAX(total_holding_gain) OVER() - MIN(total_holding_gain) OVER()), 0) AS norm_holding_gain,
           (total_scenario_shift - MIN(total_scenario_shift) OVER()) / NULLIF((MAX(total_scenario_shift) OVER() - MIN(total_scenario_shift) OVER()), 0) AS norm_scenario_shift
    FROM combined
) t
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

               SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
),
rebalance AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
),
scenario AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS scenario_allocation_shift
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
),
joined AS (
        SELECT p.investor_id,
               c.net_cash_flow,
               r.total_rebalance_amount,
               s.scenario_allocation_shift
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
        INNER JOIN cash c ON p.investor_id = c.investor_id
        INNER JOIN rebalance r ON p.investor_id = r.investor_id
        INNER JOIN scenario s ON p.investor_id = s.investor_id
),
norms AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               net_cash_flow,
               total_rebalance_amount,
               scenario_allocation_shift,
               (net_cash_flow - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER ()) - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER (), 0) AS norm_net_cash_flow,
               (total_rebalance_amount - MIN(total_rebalance_amount) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(total_rebalance_amount) OVER ()) - MIN(total_rebalance_amount) OVER (), 0) AS norm_total_rebalance_amount,
               (scenario_allocation_shift - MIN(scenario_allocation_shift) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(scenario_allocation_shift) OVER ()) - MIN(scenario_allocation_shift) OVER (), 0) AS norm_scenario_allocation_shift
        FROM joined
)
SELECT investor_id,
       100.0 * (norm_net_cash_flow + norm_total_rebalance_amount + norm_scenario_allocation_shift) / 3.0 AS transaction_rebalance_index
FROM norms
ORDER BY transaction_rebalance_index DESC, investor_id
LIMIT 10;

WITH cash AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow_raw
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    sector AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment_raw
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    risk AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               AVG(risk_score) AS risk_score_raw
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    joined AS (
        SELECT i.investor_id,
               cash.net_cash_flow_raw,
               sector.total_sector_investment_raw,
               risk.risk_score_raw
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 i
        INNER JOIN cash   ON i.investor_id = cash.investor_id
        INNER JOIN sector ON i.investor_id = sector.investor_id
        INNER JOIN risk   ON i.investor_id = risk.investor_id
    ),
    norms AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               net_cash_flow_raw,
               total_sector_investment_raw,
               risk_score_raw,
               (net_cash_flow_raw - MIN(net_cash_flow_raw) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(net_cash_flow_raw) OVER ()) - MIN(net_cash_flow_raw) OVER (), 0) AS net_cash_flow_norm,
               (total_sector_investment_raw - MIN(total_sector_investment_raw) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(total_sector_investment_raw) OVER ()) - MIN(total_sector_investment_raw) OVER (), 0) AS total_sector_investment_norm,
               (risk_score_raw - MIN(risk_score_raw) OVER ()) / NULLIF((MAX(risk_score_raw) OVER ()) - MIN(risk_score_raw) OVER (), 0) AS risk_score_norm
        FROM joined
    ),
    final AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               100.0 * ((net_cash_flow_norm + total_sector_investment_norm + risk_score_norm) / 3.0) AS composite_score
        FROM norms
    )
SELECT investor_id,
       composite_score
FROM final
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH
  cash AS (
    SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
  ),
  risk AS (
    SELECT investor_id, AVG(risk_score) AS risk_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
  ),
  goal AS (
    SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_shortfall
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
  ),
  joined AS (
    SELECT p.investor_id,
           cash.net_cash_flow,
           risk.risk_score,
           goal.avg_shortfall
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS p
    INNER JOIN cash ON p.investor_id = cash.investor_id
    INNER JOIN risk ON p.investor_id = risk.investor_id
    INNER JOIN goal ON p.investor_id = goal.investor_id
  )
SELECT
  investor_id,
  100.0 * (
    (
      (net_cash_flow - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER ()) / NULLIF(MAX(net_cash_flow) OVER () - MIN(net_cash_flow) OVER (), 0)
    + (risk_score - MIN(risk_score) OVER ()) / NULLIF(MAX(risk_score) OVER () - MIN(risk_score) OVER (), 0)
    + (1 - (
        (avg_shortfall - MIN(avg_shortfall) OVER ()) / NULLIF(MAX(avg_shortfall) OVER () - MIN(avg_shortfall) OVER (), 0)
      ))
    ) / 3.0
  ) AS composite_score
FROM joined
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH cf_sum AS (
        SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow_sum
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    reb_sum AS (
        SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_sum
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    sec_sum AS (
        SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_invest_sum
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    )
SELECT
    b.risk_tolerance,
    AVG(cf_sum.net_cash_flow_sum) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
    (
        SELECT AVG(cf.amount)
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 ip
        LEFT JOIN ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 cf ON ip.investor_id = cf.investor_id
        WHERE (ip.risk_tolerance = b.risk_tolerance)
           OR (ip.risk_tolerance IS NULL AND b.risk_tolerance IS NULL)
    ) AS avg_cash_flow_amount,
    AVG(reb_sum.total_rebalance_sum) AS avg_total_rebalance_amount,
    AVG(sec_sum.total_sector_invest_sum) AS avg_total_sector_investment,
    (
        SELECT AVG(ph.risk_score)
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 ip
        LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 ph ON ip.investor_id = ph.investor_id
        WHERE (ip.risk_tolerance = b.risk_tolerance)
           OR (ip.risk_tolerance IS NULL AND b.risk_tolerance IS NULL)
    ) AS avg_risk_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 b
LEFT JOIN cf_sum ON b.investor_id = cf_sum.investor_id
LEFT JOIN reb_sum ON b.investor_id = reb_sum.investor_id
LEFT JOIN sec_sum ON b.investor_id = sec_sum.investor_id
GROUP BY b.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY b.risk_tolerance;

holding AS (

    GROUP BY investor_id
),
sector AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
    WHERE total_investment IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
goal AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(shortfall) AS avg_goal_shortfall
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    WHERE shortfall IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
)

INNER JOIN holding ON p.investor_id = holding.investor_id
INNER JOIN sector ON p.investor_id = sector.investor_id
INNER JOIN goal   ON p.investor_id = goal.investor_id
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, p.investor_id ASC

WITH cash AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    rebalance AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    scenario AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_scenario_shift
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    goal AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               AVG(shortfall) AS avg_goal_shortfall
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    )
SELECT
    sub.investor_id,
    100.0 * (
        (CASE WHEN (sub.net_cf_max - sub.net_cf_min) = 0 THEN 0
              ELSE (sub.net_cash_flow - sub.net_cf_min) / (sub.net_cf_max - sub.net_cf_min) END) +
        (CASE WHEN (sub.reb_max - sub.reb_min) = 0 THEN 0
              ELSE (sub.total_rebalance_amount - sub.reb_min) / (sub.reb_max - sub.reb_min) END) +
        (CASE WHEN (sub.shift_max - sub.shift_min) = 0 THEN 0
              ELSE (sub.total_scenario_shift - sub.shift_min) / (sub.shift_max - sub.shift_min) END) +
        (1 - (CASE WHEN (sub.goal_max - sub.goal_min) = 0 THEN 0
                    ELSE (sub.avg_goal_shortfall - sub.goal_min) / (sub.goal_max - sub.goal_min) END))
    ) / 4.0 AS composite_score
FROM (
    SELECT
        b.investor_id,
        c.net_cash_flow,
        r.total_rebalance_amount,
        s.total_scenario_shift,
        g.avg_goal_shortfall,
        MIN(c.net_cash_flow) OVER () AS net_cf_min,
        MAX(c.net_cash_flow) OVER () AS net_cf_max,
        MIN(r.total_rebalance_amount) OVER () AS reb_min,
        MAX(r.total_rebalance_amount) OVER () AS reb_max,
        MIN(s.total_scenario_shift) OVER () AS shift_min,
        MAX(s.total_scenario_shift) OVER () AS shift_max,
        MIN(g.avg_goal_shortfall) OVER () AS goal_min,
        MAX(g.avg_goal_shortfall) OVER () AS goal_max
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 b
    INNER JOIN cash c ON b.investor_id = c.investor_id
    INNER JOIN rebalance r ON b.investor_id = r.investor_id
    INNER JOIN scenario s ON b.investor_id = s.investor_id
    INNER JOIN goal g ON b.investor_id = g.investor_id
) sub
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;
